about_the_game:
Overview

"You can no longer walk..." You've collapsed from the relentless grind of daily work. As your vision fades and you start to lose consciousness, you find yourself standing before a massive mountain.

"You may not be able to walk, but who said you can't climb?"

And so, your long and precipitous climb begins. But do not worry. After all, you still have the ability to use your hands and feet.

How to play

Only a mouse is needed to play this game. Drag your hands and feet to climb the steep mountain. Be careful not to let go with both hands, as it will result in a fall. Although you can't grab rocks using your feet, you can convert the power from stepping into climbing strength.

Features

  • A very intuitive, standard climbing style

  • Opportunity to invite friends for mutual encouragement during the climb

  • Earn in-game currency and purchase a variety of avatars in the shop

  • Over 100 avatars to choose from and make your own

Start your ascent and reclaim your power today. Will you conquer the mountain, or will

  • Individuals and organizations alike can stream content without requiring explicit permission.

  • Monetization is allowed only when utilizing features provided by the video streaming platform.

  • Please include the game's name in the video or streaming title, and provide a link to our Steam page in the description, if possible.

  • We hold no responsibility for any damages resulting from streaming videos of this game.

  • These guidelines are subject to change without prior notice.
